import pandas as pd

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

iris = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set the plot style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a pairplot with hue based on species

# Set the title
plt.suptitle('Iris Flower Species Classification', y=1.02)
